title: Vivacious
subtitle: Animus — life, growth, renewal
text: Vivacious blood is called Animus in the older alchemical tongue: the soul, the animating force, the stubborn pressure of living things. It closes wounds, feeds growth, and remembers survival before it remembers harm. The Vivacious enzyme is the sign by which this tendency is handled in practice, but Harbinger records treat Animus as its truer name. Life wants to live. That is not complicated.
